items.title: Week’s Best: 4 Factors for Deciding When to Claim Social Security
items.summary: Figuring out when to claim Social Security is no simple task, and it’s one of the most important decisions financial advisors can help clients with.  Optimal timing depends on personal circumstances, savings goals, and the needs of one’s spouse, retirement expert Mike Lynch writes.
